name: tpl-existence-3-goal
task: Get into the locked room and pick up the ball.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task commands both events unconditionally — get into the locked room (Existence(target_room_entered) hard) and pick up the ball (Existence(target_picked_up) hard). Both are goals with no order stated between them, and the machine's FINAL_STATE u3 requires both. Neither clause is redundant: even though the environment makes pickup imply entry, the task states entry as its own requirement, and the compiler confirms no redundancy and both events in every finishing run.

texts: Get into the locked room at least once.
Pick up the designated target ball at least once.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !target_picked_up&target_room_entered) -> u1
(u0, target_picked_up&!target_room_entered) -> u2
(u0, target_picked_up&target_room_entered) -> u3
(u1, target_picked_up) -> u3
(u2, target_room_entered) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !target_picked_up&target_room_entered, u1) -> 1
(u0, target_picked_up&!target_room_entered, u2) -> 1
(u0, target_picked_up&target_room_entered, u3) -> 12
(u1, target_picked_up, u3) -> 11
(u2, target_room_entered, u3) -> 11
